title: View dashboard risk summary and open a risky project
description: Verifies that the overview dashboard loads key decision metrics and lets the user drill into a risky project.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to load
Verify KPI totals are displayed
Verify risk distribution and early warning summary are displayed
Click a risky project from the dashboard
Verify the project detail page is displayed

title: Inspect project predictions and explainability
description: Verifies that a project detail page shows forecast outputs and SHAP-based explanation data for decision support.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects/1
Wait for the project detail page to load
Verify forecast outputs are displayed
Verify explainability data is displayed
Verify milestone timeline data is displayed

title: Acknowledge an active alert
description: This verifies that an operations user can review active alerts and acknowledge a critical alert so it is removed or updated in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /alerts
Select the most critical active alert
Acknowledge the selected alert
Verify the alert is no longer shown as active or its acknowledged state is displayed

title: Review project progress and milestone context
description: Verifies that a project detail page presents the progress curves and milestones needed to understand delivery status.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects/1
Wait for the project detail page to load
Verify progress curve data is displayed
Verify milestone timeline data is displayed

title: Review dashboard sector breakdown
description: Verifies that the overview dashboard shows the sector breakdown needed for a quick portfolio scan.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to load
Verify sector breakdown data is displayed
Verify summary cards for the dashboard are displayed

title: Search and filter projects in the explorer
description: Verifies that the project explorer can be used to narrow the list of projects by common filters and still show results.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Wait for the explorer to load
Select a sector filter
Select a state filter
Select a risk tier filter
Select a cost filter
Verify matching project results are displayed
Verify paging metadata is displayed

title: Compare model metrics and ablation results
description: This verifies that a data analyst can review benchmark metrics and CUF ablation results to compare model quality on the models page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /models
Verify benchmark metrics are displayed
Verify CUF ablation results are displayed

title: Open project details from the explorer
description: Verifies that a project selected in the explorer opens the deep-dive detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Wait for the explorer to load
Click a project in the results list
Verify the project detail page is displayed
Verify project profile information is displayed

title: Review alert ordering and categories
description: This verifies that the alerts list surfaces active warnings in a usable order with severity and category information visible for prioritization.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /alerts
Verify active alerts are displayed
Verify severity and category information is displayed for the alerts

title: Sort and paginate explorer results
description: Verifies that users can change the project ordering and move through paginated explorer results.

steps.description: Navigate to /explorer
Wait for the explorer to load
Select a sort option for the project list
Click the next page control
Verify project results are still displayed
Verify paging metadata is updated

title: Identify the strongest forecasting model
description: This verifies that the models page makes it possible to determine which model performs best for risk forecasting from the displayed comparison data.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /models
Verify the comparative model performance data is displayed
Verify the strongest model for forecasting risk is identifiable from the comparison

title: Show an empty alert state
description: This verifies that the alerts page clearly communicates when there are no active warnings and still provides an informative summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /alerts
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify an informational summary is displayed

title: Handle a project detail page for a nonexistent project
description: Verifies that an invalid project route shows a not-found state instead of project content.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects/999999
Wait for the project detail page to load
Verify a not-found message is displayed
Verify project detail content is not displayed

title: Handle unsupported model ablation filters
description: This verifies that unsupported ablation parameters are rejected in the UI flow and that the page shows a validation error instead of invalid comparison results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /models
Apply an unsupported filter or parameter in the ablation controls
Verify a validation error is displayed
Verify invalid comparison results are not displayed
